name: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next
summary: Download open weights for a 125B mixture-of-experts model that activates only 6B per token, so it runs fast on modest hardware with a 262K context. Hosted version is $0.16 per million input tokens.

name: Built-in browser in Cowork
summary: Hand off web chores — filling forms, pulling numbers out of a dashboard — to a browser that lives inside the desktop app. No extension to install, and it never touches your own tabs or passwords.

name: GLM-5.3-Flash
summary: Swap in a multimodal 1M-context model for $0.075 per million input tokens during the launch promo through Sept 9. Weights are MIT on Hugging Face if you'd rather self-host.

name: Wan 3.0
summary: Generate a 30-second video in one continuous shot with director-style camera moves, or turn a PDF or slide deck straight into video. API only, from $0.05 per output second at 480p.

name: Keenable Search API
summary: Give your agent live web search and clean-markdown page fetch over a 100-billion-document index. The MCP server works with no API key at all — point Claude Code or Cursor at it and go.

name: Aloud
summary: Talk through your app while it records voice, screen, and transcript, then hand the cleaned-up plan to Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex as tasks. Whisper runs on-device, so nothing leaves your Mac.

name: Firefly Audio
summary: Generate licensed music, voiceovers, and sound effects for your videos from text prompts — 45 voice profiles, a multitrack timeline, and clearance to use all of it commercially. Broadly available in Firefly now.

name: GPT-Image-2 transparent backgrounds
summary: Generate icons, stickers, and product shots as real alpha-channel PNGs by passing background=transparent — no background-removal step. Works in text-to-image, editing, and the Responses image tool, at no extra cost.
